description: List the signed-in user's pending suggested time entries across every matter they can access, for startDate through endDate (one to seven days, bounded in timezoneId). Days come in date order, each with its matters and their suggestions; a day or matter with nothing pending is omitted. Items carry the same fields as time-entries.suggestions.list. Accept or dismiss one with time-entries.suggestions.decisions.create on its matter.

endDate.description: Day the suggestions are computed for (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)

startDate.description: Day the suggestions are computed for (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)

timezoneId.description: IANA time zone that bounds the day (e.g. Europe/Prague); an accepted entry is dated in it
